race.description: Retravision - J P Stratton Cup Ms Pace (G2)
race.comment: PINSEEKER NZ (6) made an encouraging start in WA when he came from a similar draw to place here last week. Proven second-up so should be improved and won the only time he attempted this longer distance so could progress enough to win. MAGNIFICENT STORM NZ (9) has yet to find his brilliant best so far this time in but there was improvement last start. Has another wide draw but has won eight of 10 third-up attempts so could be ready to find his best. RUNKLE CRUNCH NZ (11) took advantage of a good draw to lead and take out the Golden Nugget last start. Draws on the back row this time but he is a talent. MIGHTY RONALDO (3) has enjoyed the better draws of late, finishing second at his last two. Gets another favourable barrier so he is a player. GOLDEN LODE NZ (1) should be nearing his peak now so can show his best from the inside draw.
